name: @ondewo/csi-client-nodejs
description: ONDEWO Communication System Integration (CSI) Client library for Nodejs
author: ONDEWO GmbH <office@ondewo.com>

scripts.build:auth: tsc auth/offlineTokenProvider.ts auth/grpcChannel.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --declaration --outDir auth
scripts.pretest: tsc auth/offlineTokenProvider.ts auth/offlineTokenProvider.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && tsc auth/grpcChannel.ts auth/grpcChannel.spec.ts tests/releaseNotes.spec.ts tests/releaseCredentials.spec.ts tests/entryPoint.spec.ts tests/releaseProcess.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build/tls
scripts.pretest:examples: tsc examples/listS2sPipelines.ts examples/listS2sPipelines.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build/examples
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc examples/listS2sPipelines.ts examples/listS2sPipelines.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --noEmit --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types
